map.GA 与 HbA1c 有什么区别？: What is the difference between GA and HbA1c?
map.HbA1c 反映约 2–3 个月平均血糖，GA 反映约 2–4 周，时间窗更短，: HbA1c reflects average blood glucose over about 2-3 months, while GA reflects about 2-4 weeks, a shorter window that is more sensitive to recent changes.
map.哪些情况 GA 也会失真？: In which situations is GA also distorted?
